rows.notes: Arithmetic only: assumes the same tenancy, no increases since June 1, 2019, a current lawful $3,150 base rent, all skipped rates properly banked and an eligible date in the 1.6% period. None is verified; no amount is recommended. A >10% increase generally needs 90 days, but notice alone does not establish legality. Proposed File 261020 may affect it (F46).
